title: Small candle
body:
"A dyeable candle that's smol, short, and perfect for ambience."

Description

The Small Candle is part of the candle series of items sold at the Monstrous Manor for the 2025 Halloween event. It can be bought at the Monstrous Manor or from Halloween Poppers. This version has about the same width as the tall candle but shorter.

Trivia

  • This item (like all the other candles) can be dyed.
  • When interacted with, it can be lit up with [F]
  • Candles can be placed in candle holder or fancy candle holders
When interacted, candle has a flame
